reading_notes: The text and Fig. 12 place R60/R53 and R59/R52 on the constant 7.15 V A2 reference. R60 controls the upper threshold branch, R59 the lower branch in this paragraph; later service-adjustment prose reverses the screen-region labels.

Fig. 12 draws C23 from that reference to the return, whereas the board-schematic page-10 scan draws C23 from A3 physical pin 6 to return. This manual read records one side of the known conflict and does not resolve the installed board wiring.

V24 is drawn from the upper threshold branch to A3 physical pin 4, the inverting input; the cathode is at that input. R59/R60 are shown as adjustable parts, but Fig. 12 does not establish installed wiper positions.
